codes.meaning_vi: Seed nam trong anh nhung vung lan can khong co metric depth hop le.
Khong co connected component depth hop le nao ho tro seed RoboRefer, hoac seed nam ngoai anh.
Component co seed nho hon nguong dien tich toi thieu.
Component co seed qua lon nhung van nam gon trong ROI.
Component qua lon va tiep tuc den bien ROI; day la heuristic hinh hoc, khong phai semantic ground truth.
Component cham bien anh khi che do fail-closed duoc bat.
Cua so 3D da du mau nhung position standard deviation vuot nguong.
